development_partition.definition: carved from the 85 canonical TRAIN images ONLY, never from testA/testB -- satisfies the instruction's allowance for 'a predefined development partition' for early-stopping decisions
development_partition.method: stratified 80/20 split by grade label, sklearn train_test_split, random_state=42

data_split.patch_inclusion_rule: >= 10% valid anatomical-target coverage (same threshold established in Stage 0/0-recalibration and Stage 8, reused for consistency, not re-chosen)

plain_cnn.class: PlainCNNDualHead (code_v2/baseline_cnn_dualhead.py, NEW file -- code_v2/baseline_cnn.py from Phase 1R is NOT modified)
plain_cnn.backbone: same channel widths as Phase 1R's PlainCNN (c1=64, c2=64 raw channels) for comparable non-equivariant capacity
plain_cnn.q_head: plain Conv2d(c2, 2, k=3, pad=1) -> dense (q1,q2), no equivariance constraint
plain_cnn.label: PLAIN CNN BASELINE -- no equivariance, no physical typing

model2.class: P4MOrientationNet (code/model.py, UNCHANGED -- the original pilot's implementation)
model2.label: POST-HOC / UN-TYPED ORIENTATION REPRESENTATION -- 8 raw regular-representation channels, filter index 0, angle assignment rot_idx*90deg (established in the original pilot), NOT constrained by representation theory
model2.q_construction: code_v2/model2_posthoc_q.py (NEW, torch-differentiable port of code/math_utils.py::Q_from_orientation_response's formula -- code/math_utils.py itself is NOT modified)

loss.L_Q: masked MSE on (q1,q2) at Stage-4-valid locations, same resolution-alignment convention (2x2 avg-pool target, all-4-valid mask rule) established in code_v2/model3_loss.py, reused for both baselines for a structurally fair comparison
loss.note: identical loss STRUCTURE and lambda_Q applied to both baselines, differing only in how each model constructs its Q output (typed vs post-hoc vs unconstrained) -- not tuned per-model

optimizer.note: same value already established in Stage 7/8, reused for consistency -- not re-tuned for Stage 9

training_protocol.early_stopping_metric: dev set L_total (from the train_inner/dev partition defined above, NEVER testA/testB)

held_out_evaluation.model2_permutation_null: applied to Model 2 only, reusing the exact channel-permutation methodology from code/experiments.py::channel_permutation_null (original pilot) -- NOT applied to Model 3 (not trained this stage) since it has no arbitrary channel-to-angle mapping
